description: Source code for xemit.c, part of the LibXDiff library, implementing diff emission functions including record emission, hunk generation, and diff output.

methods.name: xdl_emit_record
methods.description: Emits a diff record for a specific line in a file, with a prefix indicating change type.

methods.name: saturating_add
methods.description: Performs addition with saturation to prevent overflow.

methods.name: xdl_get_hunk
methods.description: Finds the latest change atom to include in a diff hunk based on configuration.

methods.name: def_ff
methods.description: Default function to extract a function name or identifier from a record.

methods.name: match_func_rec
methods.description: Matches a record to find a function name or identifier.

methods.name: is_func_rec
methods.description: Checks if a record represents a function.

methods.name: get_func_line
methods.description: Retrieves the line number of a function start within a file.

methods.name: is_empty_rec
methods.description: Checks if a record is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diff
methods.description: Main function to emit a diff between two files based on change list and configuration.
